# BlogApp

## Summary

The blog's hero card — a full publication in one card. The isolated view is a portal with two modes: **Site** (magazine front page: draggable lead story, featured slots, Writer's Picks carousel, games rail, Latest Posts feed with category filter pills) and **Admin** (searchable card library with per-type filters and one-click create for posts/authors/categories). A left drawer carries a theme picker (any style-reference Theme card) and a drag-source library of all posts. Layout is container-query responsive to the card's own width; the `.blog-scope` token chain maps `--blog-*` design tokens onto the semantic theme vocabulary, so both --blog-* themes and plain semantic themes re-skin the site.

## Import

```js
import { BlogApp } from '../blog-app';
```

## Usage

Create one BlogApp instance per publication; drag posts from the drawer library onto the lead/featured slots. Fields: `lead` (linksTo BlogPost), `featured` (linksToMany), `games` (linksToMany Game), `filters` (admin filter list), plus `cardInfo.theme` for the site-wide look.
